sources.quote: Search the Canadian Intellectual Property Office database before you commit to a name or mark, and register once you do
sources.title: Introduction to the Canadian Trademarks Database
sources.evidence: The Canadian Trademarks Database has been developed by the Canadian Intellectual Property Office (CIPO) to provide users with extensive information on Canadian trademarks registered from 1865 to the present. You can search and study more than 1.4 million Canadian trademarks. This is an initial search only; let an IP professional verify and complement your search.

sources.quote: update Google Business Profile carefully (name changes can trigger re-verification)
sources.title: Edit your Business Profile - Google Business Profile Help
sources.evidence: If you change your business name after it's verified, you might need to verify your business again. To keep your business info accurate, changes to your business info may require re-verification.

sources.title: Site Moves and Migrations | Google Search Central | Documentation | Google for Developers
sources.evidence: Google recommends server side permanent redirects from the old URLs to the new URLs, using HTTP permanent redirects such as 301 and 308 if possible. For small or medium sites, move all URLs simultaneously; retain control of your old site domain for at least 180 days.
